latest_release.name: Version 2.1.0
latest_release.body:
# Version 2.1.0 - 2026-03-18 - qol updates
## Changelog
### Added
  - Add a sidebar that replaces the header
  - Add a navigation bar
  - Add an "About Wrapper" popup when clicking on logo
  - Add a search bar to the video list
  - Add a grid view to the video list
  - Add zoom setting to the video list
  - Reimplement movie/starter uploading
  - Add options to edit and play starters
  - Add a watermark manager to the settings window
  - Add download button in the character creator
  - Add drag-and-drop character uploading
  - Add support for more file types in asset importer
  - Add option to import video files as sound assets
  - Add missing theme icons in the studio
  - Add an exit button to the studio
  - Add option to flip backdrops
  - Add embedded CC to the studio
  - Add timeline scaling options
  - Add pre-generated stock character thumbnails
  - Add Lil Peepz stock characters
  - Add missing language names
  - Log files
### Removed
  - Remove Discord rich presence
  - Remove TTS ad in the studio
### Changed
  - Move settings page to a window
  - Convert source code to TypeScript
  - Build system now utilizes esbuild
  - Rewrite frontend in the Vue framework
  - Change method of generating IDs
  - Merge Blood on the Dance Floor into Lil Peepz
  - Stock characters are dynamically added to theme XMLs
### Fixed
  - Fix head props not being parsed correctly when zipping movie
  - Fix Wrapper starting with incorrect port
  - Fix truncated themelist not applying to create window
  - Fix Zoom/DevTools shortcuts
  - Fix text-to-speech voices
  - Fix movies failing to load when assets are missing
  - Fix "save and close" button in the studio
  - Patch animation SWFs to use unsigned libraries
